member.name: OdooRequestModel
member.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 request sent to Odoo /jsonrpc. Normally created by ; use the static factory methods with for calls not covered by the client.

member.name: Id
member.summary: Request id - Odoo returns it in the answer. Unique within the process.

member.name: Jsonrpc
member.summary: JSON-RPC protocol version, always 2.0 for Odoo.

member.name: Method
member.summary: JSON-RPC method, always call for Odoo.

member.name: Params
member.summary: Odoo service, method and arguments of the call.

member.name: ctor
member.summary: Creates JSON-RPC 2.0 call request with a new unique id.

member.name: ctor.Method
member.summary: Creates request with given protocol version and method and a new unique id.

member.name: ctor.Id
member.summary: Creates request with all values given.

member.name: Version
member.summary: Request for common.version - Odoo server version; does not need login.

member.name: Login
member.summary: Request for common.login - returns user id, or false for wrong database, user name or password.

member.name: ModelFields
member.summary: Request for fields_get - field definitions of an Odoo model.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.

member.name: Search
member.summary: Request for search - ids of records matching the query filters.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Filters, order, offset and limit; null means all records.

member.name: SearchRead
member.summary: Request for search_read - records matching the query, with requested fields.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Filters, fields, order, offset and limit; null means all records with all fields.

member.name: Read
member.summary: Request for read - records with given ids. Filters of are ignored.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Returned fields; null means all fields.

member.name: SearchCount
member.summary: Request for search_count - number of records matching the query filters.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.

member.name: Create
member.summary: Request for create - creates a record (or many records when is a list).
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Values of the record: model class, or a list of them.

member.name: Update
member.summary: Request for write - writes the same values to records with given ids.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.

member.name: Delete
member.summary: Request for unlink - deletes records with given ids.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.

member.name: Metadata
member.summary: Request for get_metadata - creation / modification info and external id (xml id) of records.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.

member.name: Action
member.summary: Request calling any model method with as the single positional argument (usually record ids).
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Single positional argument, usually record id(s).

member.name: ActionCollection
member.summary: Request calling any model method with as the whole list of positional arguments.
member.param: Id of a logged in user.
Array of positional arguments; the first one is usually record id(s).

member.name: MapQuery
member.summary: Builds keyword arguments of execute_kw (context, fields, order, offset, limit) from context and query.
member.returns: Keyword arguments, or null when there are none.

member.name: GetRequestFilters
member.summary: Builds the domain argument of execute_kw from query filters; no query or no filters gives an empty domain (all records).

member.name: OdooRequestParams
member.summary: params of an Odoo JSON-RPC call: service (common / object), its method (e.g. execute_kw) and arguments.

member.name: Params.Service
member.summary: Odoo service: common (version, login) or object (model methods).

member.name: Params.Method
member.summary: Method of the service, e.g. login, execute, execute_kw.

member.name: Params.Args
member.summary: Positional arguments of the method, e.g. database, user id, password, model, model method, its arguments and keyword arguments.

member.name: Params.Url
member.summary: Url the request is sent to; not serialized.

member.name: Params.ctor
member.summary: Creates call parameters. Trailing null arguments are removed (e.g. missing keyword arguments).
member.param: Url the request is sent to.

member.name: Params.PrepareParams
member.summary: Removes trailing null arguments, so optional arguments are not sent.
